title: The Reporting Map Is Not One Map
subtitle: How a global CFO files climate data when Washington proposes rescission, Sacramento still wants Scope 1 and 2 by 10 November, and ISSB keeps spreading
description: An HBS-style teaching case set on 2 September 2026. After the SEC proposed full rescission of its 2024 climate rules and CARB moved the first SB 253 Scope 1 and 2 filing to 10 November 2026, a composite mid-cap industrial CFO must choose a reporting architecture across California, ISSB markets, and a narrowed CSRD. Real Commission releases, CARB notices, Council votes and Faber’s Frankfurt count are woven through a classroom decision.
